Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride

Milford, OH · Road · Mixed

No-dropBeginner friendly

Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride is a road group ride in Milford, OH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Bishop's Bicycles. About 15 or 20 miles, pace of the slowest rider. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: pace of the slowest rider. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @cincycycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride group ride

An easy club ride on the Little Miami Bike Trail and roads around Milford. Fifteen or twenty miles at the pace of the slowest rider. No one left behind.
